grounding.from: The question says only "Vancouver" and gives no place. There are two Vancouvers (British Columbia, Canada and Washington, USA), so I looked up both.

value.answer: Assuming you mean Vancouver, BC: tomorrow's a mix of sun and cloud, high around 15°C, then showers creep in by the evening, low of 11. If you meant Vancouver, Washington: mostly sunny and dry, high near 64°F. Which one were you after?
